remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home, situated on nearly an acre in the desirable Clarence School District. Built in 2011, this impressive residence offers thoughtfully designed living space blending elegance, functionality, and amenities. Step inside to discover an inviting open-concept floor plan featuring a spacious kitchen with granite countertops, rich cabinetry, and a generous center island, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. A two-season Florida sunroom provides a light-filled retreat to relax in and enjoy. A standout feature of this home is its thoughtfully designed, wheelchair-friendly first floor, featuring 36-inch doorways, a convenient first-floor primary suite, and a zero-entry shower. Designed with accessibility in mind, the layout offers enhanced comfort and ease of mobility.
The primary suite provides a relaxing escape with a luxurious steam shower and heated bathroom floors. Additional living space includes a versatile bonus room above the garage and a full basement with impressive 9-foot ceilings, offering endless possibilities. Additional highlights include a heated 3.5-car garage, whole-house generator, closed-cell spray foam insulation, new central air conditioning (2025), and two hot water tanks (2022). Outside, enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds featuring an irrigation system, partially fenced yard, and outdoor hot tub—perfect for relaxation and entertaining!

Open house on Sunday, October 18th from 1:00-3:00pm. Showings start on Wednesday October 14th and offers due Monday the 19th at noon.
